final_message:
I built the Ploverdesk landing page and wrote the design system, but I couldn't run `npm run build`: the sandbox blocks `npm` and `node` ("operation not permitted"). So the page has not been compiled, type-checked or seen in a browser. Nobody could validate anything this session, so the theses and design system are all marked **UNVALIDATED**.

**What I built**
- **`src/App.tsx`:** one page, written in plain language for finance leads:
  - a short header;
  - the opening section: "Only the invoice lines that don't match reach your desk.";
  - how the three-way match works;
  - a real table of the three kinds of mismatch;
  - export (CSV or API) and Frankfurt hosting;
  - a price band: 290 EUR per month per company, no limit on users, 14-day trial with no credit card;
  - a footer line: founded in 2025, six people in Rotterdam.
- **Calls to action:** every trial link uses the same label, "Start the 14-day trial", and goes to `/trial`. The demo is a plain text link, "Book a demo", going to `/demo`.
- **No invented content:** no logos, testimonials, example numbers or product screenshots. The only figures are the ones in the brief.
- **`src/tokens.css` and `src/index.css`:** every value comes from the tokens; the colour hex values exist only in the token file.
- **`index.html`:** a real page title and description.
- **`MASTER.md`:** the design system, with the theses, the assumptions I made in place of the founders' answers, the dials, and what I kept and dropped from the design-system lookup.
- **`preview/thesis.html` and `preview/design-system.html`:** throwaway previews of the direction and the design system.

**Direction (UNVALIDATED)**
- **Visual:** white page, near-black text, grey for secondary text. The one colour, a burnt vermilion `#B03A0E`, appears only on the mismatch labels, because the product only shows the lines that don't match; the trial button is solid black.
- **Typeface:** the visitor's system sans, with no web font. A page that promises EU hosting shouldn't send visitors' IP addresses to a font service.
- **Layout:** left-aligned, flat, 2px corners, no shadows.
- **Motion:** 140ms colour changes on hover only, nothing moves on scroll, and transitions drop to 0ms when the visitor has reduced motion turned on.
- **Hairlines:** two on purpose, under the header and between the table rows.

**Audit: 11 checked, 1 problem found and fixed, 5 handed over**
- **Fixed:** the wordmark's hover state changed nothing visible; it now shows an underline (`src/index.css:73`).
- **False positive:** the audit script still flags the other three hover rules (`src/index.css:364`, `:374`, `:383`). Their transitions are on the base rules (`:304`, `:347`), which apply on hover too.
- **What the code delivers:** the colour, easing, 140ms timing, single typeface and flat components all trace back to the tokens.
- **Reduced motion:** `src/tokens.css:79` sets the transition duration to 0ms.
- **Layout and performance:**
  - no layout properties animated, no exit animations needed (nothing unmounts), no permanent `will-change`;
  - visible focus ring at `:focus-visible`;
  - no clickable `div`s;
  - buttons and links are at least 44px tall to tap.
- **Interactive states:** buttons and links have default, hover, focus and active states. Disabled is defined but no control on the page uses it.
- **Contrast, computed:** body text 17.65:1, grey text 6.38:1 (5.84:1 on the grey band), vermilion 6.07:1, secondary button border 3.68:1.
- **Reflex patterns:** none of the 18 automated checks found one. Read by hand: no fake product UI, varied layouts across sections, no em dashes.

**Not verified**
- `npm run build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`), blocked by the sandbox as above.
- The page at 375, 768, 1024 and 1440px wide: no horizontal scroll and nothing clipped. The mismatch table stacks below 640px; this is untested.
- The page with the OS reduce-motion setting on.
- A Chrome DevTools performance recording of the hover states.

Bunshin, genjutsu's multi-agent pipeline for whole websites, would fit a larger brief. For a single page I didn't propose it.

Modules loaded: tells, motion-principles, css-native, mobile-principles (its middle section was cut in the display), design-audit
Modules not loaded: ui-ux-pro-max (its lookup script ran, but I didn't read its instructions file)
